Original home of Union College, Schenectady, N. Y., built in 1797; from a photo taken
about 1860 and never before reproduced. The principal features are the fan lights over
the doors, the long Palladian windows lighting the stair wells, the cupola and railing on
the roof, the high wooden fence typical of Dutch inclusiveness. At the time this
picture was taken the building was used as a public school. It was demolished in 1900.
